item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-10-16
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

2. [Tech News] Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75

3. [Tech News] Kids are outsmarting social media bans. That’s not a problem we need to solve.

4. [Tech News] Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
